statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
There is concern for supraventricular tachycardia
The service is to capture arrhythmia while it occurs
The service is to correlate recorded events with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
The diagnosis codes billed are I48.0, I47.1, and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry is medically necessary for this patient
